newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates drop on textile package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates drop on textile package.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates dropped on Sunday amid low demand from spinners in response to a relief package announced by the government for textile industry, dealers said.

They said lowering of duties on cotton import and synthetic fibres in Saturday's package had sent spinners to drawing boards to calculate their requirements and prices suiting them. "Spinners would be looking at prices around 2,300 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) after the duty cuts," dealer Amir Nasim said.
The kerb rate for the NIAB-78 variety was at 2,125 rupees ($52.83) per maund while the MNH-93 was traded at 2,200 rupees.
